people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
translations.bsb: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
translations.kjv: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
translations.asv: And unto the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
